definitions.explanation: The two opposite sides of something — a road, a body, a piece of paper, an argument. Used for spatial sides and, by extension, two opposing parties or viewpoints.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}の{両側|りょうがわ}に{桜|さくら}が{咲|さ}いている。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms are blooming on both sides of the road.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}の{両側|りょうがわ}に{印刷|いんさつ}してください。
examples.english: Please print on both sides of the paper.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}するためには、{両側|りょうがわ}の{意見|いけん}を{聞|き}く{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: To solve the problem, we need to hear the opinions of both sides.

notes:
Compound of {両|りょう} (both) + {側|がわ} (side). The {側|がわ} reading shifts to dakuon in this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道|みち}の{両側|りょうがわ}: both sides of the road
- {両側|りょうがわ}に{並|なら}ぶ: to line up on both sides
- {両側|りょうがわ}{通行|つうこう}: two-way traffic
- {両側|りょうがわ}の{意見|いけん}: opinions from both sides

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {両方|りょうほう}: both — abstract pair (both options, both people); not spatial
- {左右|さゆう}: left and right — specifically left-right axis
- {両端|りょうたん}: both ends — the endpoints rather than the sides
